expect_red: sweep: the gate line says WHERE the as-modelled frame is, once per run, and says so plainly when no frame qualifies

mutations.contract: The gate line names the as-modelled frame by its one-based position in the run, so a reader is sent to a frame that exists.
mutations.note: The mutation drops the one-based shift: the line would send the reader to frame 79 of 80 for the frame the run calls its 80th, which is exactly the off-by-one a gate that names a frame must not have.
